title: New members can still join a gym that MettleUp has paused
what: While a gym is paused (read-only), joining it in the app with its code still works, and a member can change their name. The new member then cannot check in or order, because everything else of the gym refuses changes.
expected: A paused gym refuses new joins with a clear message (members already in can still open the app and leave, as the pause promises).
how_often: every join while a gym is paused
fix_line: Make joining check whether the gym is paused and say so; leave the leave-the-gym step as it is

title: Automatic reminder switches can still be changed, and keep reaching members, while a gym is paused
what: The reminder switches are the one gym setting the pause does not freeze: the owner of a paused gym can still save them and is told he may. Members' phones keep getting 'your plan ends soon, renew' reminders even though the desk cannot take a renewal while the gym is paused.
expected: A paused gym's reminder switches are read-only like its other settings, and the phone is told the gym is paused so renewal reminders hold until it is restored.
who: owners and members of paused gyms
how_often: only while a gym is paused
fix_line: Add the pause guard to the reminder switches and send the gym's paused state with the phone's reminder data

title: The owner's MettleUp access list never shows that a delete request was opened for the gym
what: The owner's list of what MettleUp did to the gym shows pauses, sign-outs, trial and plan changes, but not a delete request being written down or moved on, even though the request can come from a phone call or email and ends with the gym deleted for ever.
expected: A delete request on the gym, and each step of it, shows in the owner's MettleUp access list, so a wrong or unwanted request can be stopped in time.
fix_line: Add the delete-request steps to the actions the owner's access list shows
